title: Global Workspace in LLMs — the Jacobian Lens Paper

steps.title: What the Jacobian lens is
steps.body: A one-minute orientation: the Jacobian lens reads a model's internal reasoning by how a feature's representation changes across layers — a sharper cousin of the logit lens. This path walks the four-episode arc, checks your grasp where the topic has no study guide, then tests recall.

steps.title: Ep 1 — Anatomy of the Lens
steps.focus: What the J-lens measures, and why it beats the logit lens.

steps.title: Ep 2 — The Map of the Layers
steps.focus: How a feature's representation moves across layers.

steps.title: Bridge check — J-lens vs the logit lens
steps.body: In one or two sentences: how does the Jacobian lens differ from the logit lens, and why does that difference matter for reading a model's reasoning?

steps.title: Ep 3 — Surgery on Thoughts
steps.focus: Editing internal representations — what breaks, what holds.

steps.title: Ep 4 — Replicating the Paper
steps.focus: The reproduce-and-measure steps you'd actually run.

steps.title: Drill the J-lens vocabulary (9 cards)
steps.focus: Lock in the terms before the quiz.

steps.title: Reflect + go deeper
steps.body: In one line: when would you NOT trust the Jacobian lens's read of a model? Optional: listen to the Critique episode for the counter-case.
